answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 8271 Country: India Title: Hamare ghar me khathe he ke dhood pethehi namaz nahi padna chahiye? kya ye sahi hey? Question: Hamare ghar me khathe he ke dhood pethehi namaz nahi padna chahiye? kya ye sahi hey? Answer ID: 8271 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1744/1647=D/1429) It is not proved from any Hadith; therefore it is not correct. Yes, one should wash his mouth if the taste of milk is remaining therein. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
